events.title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator Demo Launches on September 30!
events.summary: Hello Pet Shop Owners! 🐾 I'm excited to announce that the Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator Demo will launch on September 30! In the demo, you'll get your first hands-on experience running your own pet shop. Set up your store, order pets and supplies, stock your shelves, care for your animals, serve customers, and grow your business. As a solo developer, I'm really looking forward to hearing your feedback and seeing what you think! The doors open on September 30! 🐶🐱🐠 See you in the shop!
